notes.title: Campaign Modifier Beta Patch Annoucment
notes.notes:
Today we are preparing the Campaign Modifier update we talked about last week. Thanks a ton everyone who gave suggestions. There where many more we wanted to add, but we ran out of time. As a reminder the goal of today's patch is two fold.
[olist]
Create more exciting ways to spice up future runs,

Allow you to remove or tweak elements of the game you'd rather play without,
[/olist]
Because stability is an ongoing priority, and since many of these modifiers drastically change the game we have decided to release them on an open beta branch. This allows us to test them out a bit before we commit them to live for everyone. 

If you would like to help us test the new modifiers early, navigate to Dice Gambit on steam, then right click -> Propertes -> Betas -> and select openbeta in the Beta Participation drop down. Friendly reminder, IF you decide to create new safe files on the beta branch, do not try to load these on the regular branch. Chances are things will break. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/02be4b3d607fee52852806e0e680ff331e8519ec.png"]

If you decide to play test and encounter a bug please join our community Discord and report the bugs, alternatively you can use the steam discussion forums, but it is harder for us to keep taps on them there.

CAMPAIGN MODIFIERS 
All Campaign Modifiers have been sorted into new categories to make browsing easier, these are:

Campaign

Game Changers

Academy 

Combat Easier 

Combat Harder

Management Easier

Management Harder


Campaign Category Additions
Long Inquisition increases all campaign deadline by 2 weeks. Can be added up to 5 times.,

Rabid Deadline decreased all campaign deadlines by 1 week. Can be added up to 3 times.,

note these campaign deadline modifiers, should not have a big impact on the games difficulty, as all mission levels are based on their respective campaign week. 
Game Changer Category Additions
Added Hacker Lineage: "Swaps all your characters Basic Attack and Basic Defend for Protocol: Attack & Protocol: Defend respectively.,

Added Circus Performers: "Swap all your characters Basic Attack for Throwing Dagger.,

Added Political Commentators: "Swap all your characters Basic Attack for Straw Man.,

Added Leg Day Trainers: "Swap all your characters Basic Attack for Kick.,

Added Micro Managers: "Swap all your characters Basic Movement for Direct.,

Added Potion Sellers: "Swap all your characters Basic Defend for Brew Elixir.,

Added Sharpshooters: "All your characters have Best Defense and Sharpshooter",

Added Vengeful Pacifists: "Swap all your characters Basic Attack for Basic Defend, all your characters also have Retaliate",

Added Con Artists: Swaps your Basic Defend with Evade.,


Academy Category Additions
Reformed Schooling System: All academy unlocks are shuffled between the relations.,

Spoiled For Choice can now be picked up to 3 times, allowing for even more class unlocks at the start of the game.,


Combat Easier
Undying: Whenever a character would be killed, they are instead returned to the estate with 1hp.,

Stone Armor Players and allies armor now block 100% of incoming damage instead of 80%,


Combat Harder
Chromatic Strength max stacks increased from 5 -> 10,

In Media Res all enemies appear on expeditions from Act 1. (Portal Heralds a still locked by act),

Paper Armor Players and allies armor now block 20% of incoming damage instead of 80%,


Management Easier
Debt Free: You family has no debt and can keep gold between expeditions.,

Good Form: Reduce all stamina lost after missions by 25% (Can be picked 3 times),


Management Harder
Bad Form: Increase all stamina lost after mission by 25% (Can be picked up to 10 times),

Gone but not forgotten: Dead and Retired characters still take up family capacity.,



Many have suggested the ability to change modifiers mid run, and while we think this is an exceptional idea, unfortunately we did not have time to do it this time around. Sorry!


Studio Notice and Future PlansStudio Vacation
Now that the launch rush is behind us, the team will be winding down and going on vacation soon. Next week most of the team will already be gone, so only expect minor bug fixes and the eventual shipping of the full modifier patch once we deem it stable. After that the team will take some time off for approximately 1 month. We may still decide to fix some critical bugs, but don't expect anything really. 

As you can imagine, the Dice Gambit launch and the last many months where quite rough, so we long for a bit of a distance away from game development. 


Future Plans
Once we are back we will be taking stock of the situation and where we are at. I think it is unlikely that we are completely done with Dice Gambit, but I also won't promise you the world. There is a none zero chance that we have to move towards game 2 in a fairly short order. Time will tell, expect more updates when we a back in action!

As always we try to be as transparent as possible, if you have any questions leave them on this post or preferably ping us on the community discord. Always open to chat. 

Thank you so much for the incredibly launch week, your amazing support and your patience as fix all last weeks issues! 

See you in Neo-Talis 
Nicos, Nina & Joshua - The Chromatic Ink Team

notes.title: Dice Gambit, Status and Development Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone! 

First of all thank you so much, to say that all the support, love and bugs have been overwhelming would be an understatement! We did not expect this much, and we are so happy and thankful to all of you! 

In Fact since Thursday last week we have already sold over 13,000 Copies! Which is absolutely amazing

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/39733169a672e4a8e3ff39e5ea10a8fad81f19b0.png"]Obviously this means that there are a bunch of bugs, issues and other balance concern we have to address, so I'd figured we would give you and update of where we are at and whats happening next!

Right now our main priority is Stability, Balance & General Game Health. We've identified a few problems we tackle first: 

Bugs & Stability Issues: This is kinda a given, we will continue ship fixes prioritizing more severe bugs first! 

Act 2 & Act 3 is too hard: We think the later acts are too difficult, and that the spikes between the acts are too severe. We did a quick fix earlier this weekend but more work to bring them inline with Act 1 will be coming, some Portal Heralds might also be nerfed individually to keep them inline.  

Veteran/Older characters are too weak: Currently your older characters tend to scale more poorly than just cycling through new Children and Spouses. This is not our intention. We like the idea of compensating new characters and making them have more potential since it helps prevent runs feeling over just because you loose a few main characters. But clearly this has swung too far in the other end. We will be doing a few buffs to older characters like reducing Infirmary Costs, Increasing leveling rate at higher levels and changing relation stat bonuses to also apply to existing characters. 

Stamina management is too rough: Enough said, stamina management is hard to balance, especially in the early game when you family roster is still small. We will continue to tweak the stamina values to make it more lenient, we are also looking at heavily buffing Recovery Facility which is way to inefficient right now. 

Chroma Is too punishing to use: We have seen some players use Chroma more liberally really getting punished in longer expeditions and while we want Chroma to bear real consequences they don't have to be quite this severe. 

Character Relations are too slow: We think progressing through the relations are going a tad too slow for what we'd like. It's especially important that you actually have time to explore the various late game classes before the game is over! 

Of course there are additional pick-ups we plan to do like allowing you to delete save files in-game or buffing expedition healing encounter and more!

We hope to address most if not all of the above changes during the next couple of days. 

We are also currently working on the first content update, this one will be adding a bunch of new campaign modifiers, half of which are designed to spice up your next round with some wacky rules, the other half will allow you to turn off parts of the game you might prefer not to play with. Like Stamina or Permadeath. 

This update will hopefully ship end of week, or next week, but time will tell since we are still focusing on the above. 

Here is a little teaser, can you spot what is wrong with this picture?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/59d03780896733db51eee695d411512f775fb4c0.png"]

We are all still reeling a bit after the crunch that is has been the last months leading up to launch. Once the game is more stable the team will be taking a much much needed break, we will likely already begin winding down from the start of the next week. 

As for future updates, nothing is set in stone yet. Once the dust has settled and we have an overview over our financials, we will plan accordingly. I know that we would all love to give this game more love, and there is many more places we can go, but at the end of the day it will depend on what we can afford.



We are 3 people working on this, so I cannot promise the world, but we will do our best! 
If you ever want to chat or here more about what is happening day to day, please consider joining our Discord!

Thanks again everyone! 
/Josh, Nina & Nicos - The Chromatic Ink Team

notes.title: Dice Game First Act - Release Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!  

We just shipped a major update to the Dice Gambit First Act - Demo. Essentially it brings it up to date with all the balance, bug fixes and mechanical changes coming to the full release! 

Just about every class in the game has been re-tuned, with several receiving brand new abilities or major reworks to existing ones. There has been major balance changes across the board as well, everything from enemies, to health, to stat changes has been tweaked ahead of the full game!

We've also added new enemies, campaign modifiers and random encounters! 

A ton of bug fixes has happened since the last release, along with several optimization changes so everything should generally run smoother than before. 

There is also several new polish and QOL elements, like Act transition cards, 3D Stecchi in the estate with Voice-Lines, many new music tracks & a fast forward options for combat! 

Some systems has also be reworked. Instead of allowing each 3D armor to be customized, each class will now have a unique armor which will be equipped when you change class. This allows us to create better looking and more visually distinct armors - though they are still re-colourable like before. 

There is so much more we could cover, but for now we will let you discover it all for yourselves! 

Remember the full version of Dice Gambit will be releasing August 14th! 

Reminder: Dice Gambit The First Act will become unavailable when the full game launches, to be replaced with a shorter 2  hour demo of the tutorial. All save files made in the existing demo, and the new one will carry into the full game.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/cdaea03cb7db42f2ef14fda7d2bdede4da18fdc5.png"]

We are almost there! 
See you next week!! :D :D :D

notes.title: Major Demo content and system patch!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! 

Big update for y’all today. Since the release last year we have been hard at work finishing up the full game along with addressing the tons of feedback we’ve received as all of you entered Neo-Talis for the first time! 

Today we are shipping a huge update to the original demo, containing many additions, new content, tweaks and much more! 

Before we go into the nitty gritty details, I want to give one warning up front. This patch will break all existing save files. Due to the amount of changes and reworks, your Inquisitor families from last year's demo will not survive the new patch, so please be mindful of that when updating. Going forward with this new release all new saves made will carry into the full game! So don’t worry, this won’t happen again. 

If you want to access the old build and your old save files you can do so via the demo beta branch: "olddemo"

Enough rambling here are the highlights: 

Academy 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/b34a12128a89821d0ba6a8abe97cdb34c3e75271.png
The following classes have been added to the game and are attainable in the demo:

 Berserker
 Director
 Alchemist
 Operator
While not fully unlockable, some abilities from the following classes will be unlockable through other means: 

 Sniper
 Gunblade
The Inquisitor class has seen a major rework and will now have a few abilities and passives from all of the game's 11 classes.

Vanguard, Shutterbug, Scorcher, Translocationalist & Knife Juggler all have seen minor adjustments and a few additions here and there. 

The Show-Off has been retired, with their best abilities now appearing in other classes. 

The Academy itself has seen some minor reworks to make it more intuitive, specifically you will now always receive an ability when you gain a new class, whether through multiclassing or not. 

Relations 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/388da2667ae05b48327c6dac714017eac8d855e7.png
Alexi Nova will now be an unlockable relation, with a corresponding encounter and mission type. 

All character relations have received new upgrades, whether it be classes, new facilities and stat bonuses as part of their relation rewards. 

Silvia's personal story has been added and will now unlock as you progress her relations. The others still need a tad more time in the oven ;) 

Character Stats
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/38a109b5d8d72ead3ab7abc4f05b0c09083d2329.png
In order to allow characters to grow in power throughout the full game, while also supporting even more diverse and varied builds we are introducing character stats. Each character will now have 8 different stats which will modify their abilities and combat potential in various ways. They are: 

 Attack Power
 Armor Power
 Buff Power
 Critical Chance
 Dodge Chance
 Initiative
 Dice Power 
 Max Health

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/3f07744c8e8b3a1957b65184d4bfdf70bea6476d.png
Every other character level you will now be offered a choice of attributes to increase, allowing you to refine their stats over time to fit their role, playstyle and build. Because of this, characters will also level up significantly faster to ensure a steady flow of upgrades and abilities. 

When marrying, the total number of stats of suitors will be based on the character you are marrying, allowing stronger characters to find stronger partners. 

When two characters get children the child stats will be based on the parents, again allowing stronger characters to get stronger children. 

This should allow new characters to always feel powerful and relevant even when recruited late in act one, or in the following acts. Many times a new character will even have more potential, as they will level faster initially due to their lower level. 

Character Stamina
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/145ed3287b583dcd32599ea38f5b79bfb70f28ec.png
All characters will now have a distinct stamina bar, which represents how well rested or exhausted they are. Characters with high stamina will receive up to 50% increased combat stats, while exhausted characters can go as low as 50% decreased stats. 

Whenever a character participates in a combat they will lose a fixed amount of stamina, and whenever a character stays home instead of participating in an expedition they will regain a large chunk of stamina. 

We want to encourage you to play with more than one single roster of characters, rewarding you for letting some rest while others embark on fights. 

Expedition roster sizes have been reduced in the early game to make it easier to manage.

Character Creator 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/4fa6b9603342d9fd46452b9aab1dbb0f7aeba69c.png
The character creator has received a huge pass of new assets, almost tripling the amount of choices available. Amongst them are a few highly requested additions such as Beards, Bald-support and dreadlocks. Along with a few more wacky options as well. 

We have also refined the character generator for children such that their assets will more closely resemble that of their parents. (Though do remember you can always edit them after the fact should you want even finer control). 

Random Encounters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/145cb03979443538d2f8dae1f50449fc406f8244.png
During expeditions you will now find random encounters which will lead to various different, well, encounters and events which yield various unique rewards. 

Save System
The cap of 3 save files has also been removed allowing you to create any number of saves. 

Additional Languages
Todays patch will now also have language support for:

 Japanese
 Simplified Chinese
 Traditional Chinese

Conclusion
Of course there are many other changes not covered in today's notes, everything from new enemies, balance changes, infirmary costs to readability changes, has been looked at and tweaked since last patch. 


That’s it for today folks. Thank you so much for your continued support and all the amazing feedback from last time around. As a small team your feedback and love means the world to us. <3 

And as always, feel free to share your opinions with us here on steam, on our discord or via the in-game survey. Your feedback is what guides us!

Thank you and stay awesome!
- Nicos, Nina & Josh - The Chromatic Ink Team

notes.title: Demo Patch Anoucment & Save File Notice
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

Since the last demo update we have been hard at work finishing the final game! As part of that we have been tweaking, adding and fixing up tons of new systems and content to better address some of the amazing feedback we have received from you all. As such we are getting ready for a huge demo patch showcasing many of the new additions. 

Not to be the developers that creates an announcement of an announcement, but later this week this patch will go live here on steam. Because the patch changes and adds several key systems, existing save files will no longer be supported with the patch update. 

We know this isn’t ideal, but the number of changes makes it impossible to port them over. Going forward with the new update we promise to maintain all new save files into the full game release. Meaning any family you make as of the new patch will be playable when the game releases, later this summer! 

For those of you who are not quite ready to say goodbye to your existing families, we will be creating a public beta branch of the demo where you can play the existing build. Your old save files should still be available on that branch - though creating a backup of your save files already now would also be smart. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41512081/9988914d10282bb04eafbd14a543fe7e3b0b2344.png

Thank you so much for the continued support! We cannot wait for you to experience everything we’ve been cooking. 

Say Awesome! 
Nicos, Nina & Joshua - The Chromatic Ink Team.

notes.title: Dice Gambit: The First Act Ver. 174 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for playing and providing feedback!

General

 You can now select character directly from the Inspection Menu.
 There is now a small hover prompt when hovering character cards showing how to inspect them.
 The Combat Timeline is now hidden during the very first tutorial mission.
 Grabbing one dice now automatically sends all other unrolled dice towards the mouse!
 Hovering an ability icon will now display the range of that ability.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the Reroll counter elements couldn't be clicked if except for the original 2.
 Removed level text "15" from empty character slots.


Audio

 Added Dauber SFX:
 Move
 Take dmg
 Die
 Spawn
 Wave attack
 Curse apply & pop
 Cast generic initial
 Cast generic fire

notes.title: Dice Gambit: The First Act Ver. 170 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
General

 Added english subtitles to the intro cinematics


Gameplay

 Shocking End will no longer target explosive barrels. (For realsies this time)
 Infirmary cost per level increased from 10 to 15
 New Feature: Death Rally - Whenever a character dies, all other characters roll 2 additional dice for the rest of the mission.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed Wild Accusation breaking on delivery points
 Fixed Second Chance not disappearing after trigger
 Fixed Profiling hitting player characters if targeting a Drip

notes.title: Dice Gambit: The First Act Ver. 165 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Small hotfix is out! Nothing big, just a few low-hanging fruit we got through feedback/bug reports :)

Thanks to everybody who played, talked in discord and answered our survey!

Gameplay

 Temporarily removed explosive barrels' ability to walk via Charm/Fear
 End Turn Button hotkey hint now shows when hovering End Turn button


Bug Fixes

 Fixed Scapegoat softlock
 Fixed not being able to perform any action after destroying a previously feared explosive barrel
 Fixed tooltip for Delivery Unit - Package Cannon
 Fixed Shocking End hitting explosive barrels
